views.name: vw_total_products_by_category
views.definition: with recursive `categorypath` as (select `tb_categories`.`id_category` AS `id_category`,`tb_categories`.`name` AS `category_name`,cast(`tb_categories`.`name` as char(1000) charset utf8mb4) AS `category_path`,1 AS `category_level` from `tb_categories` where ((`tb_categories`.`sup_id_category` is null) or (`tb_categories`.`sup_id_category` = 0)) union all select `c`.`id_category` AS `id_category`,`c`.`name` AS `name`,concat(`cp`.`category_path`,' → ',`c`.`name`) AS `CONCAT(cp.category_path, ' → ', c.name)`,(`cp`.`category_level` + 1) AS `cp.category_level + 1` from (`tb_categories` `c` join `categorypath` `cp` on((`c`.`sup_id_category` = `cp`.`id_category`)))) select `cp`.`id_category` AS `category_id`,`cp`.`category_path` AS `category_path`,`cp`.`category_level` AS `category_level`,count(`p`.`id_product`) AS `total_products`,sum((case when (`p`.`status` = 1) then 1 else 0 end)) AS `total_active_products`,sum((case when (`p`.`status` = 0) then 1 else 0 end)) AS `total_inactive_products`,0 AS `total_uncategorized_products` from ((`categorypath` `cp` left join `tbd_products_categories` `pc` on((`cp`.`id_category` = `pc`.`id_category`))) left join `tb_products` `p` on((`pc`.`id_product` = `p`.`id_product`))) group by `cp`.`id_category`,`cp`.`category_path`,`cp`.`category_level` union all select NULL AS `category_id`,'Sin categoría' AS `category_path`,0 AS `category_level`,count(`p`.`id_product`) AS `total_products`,sum((case when (`p`.`status` = 1) then 1 else 0 end)) AS `total_active_products`,sum((case when (`p`.`status` = 0) then 1 else 0 end)) AS `total_inactive_products`,count(`p`.`id_product`) AS `total_uncategorized_products` from `tb_products` `p` where `p`.`id_product` in (select `tbd_products_categories`.`id_product` from `tbd_products_categories`) is false
